title: Privacy Policy
description: How LAMID ONE collects, safeguards, and processes institutional data under strict enterprise privacy standards.

paragraphs.text: LAMID ONE operates under strict data sovereignty, role-based tenant isolation, and international privacy standards to protect your institutional intelligence.

We collect information strictly necessary to provide platform services: verified identity credentials, workspace configuration, audit trail logs, and deliverable verification assets submitted during project execution.
• Tenant Isolation: Corporate workspace intelligence is strictly partitioned with tenant-level cryptographic isolation.

Customer data is processed exclusively to execute decision calculations, maintain escrow audit trails, and ensure platform security. We never sell, rent, or monetize your business intelligence or proprietary data.
• Zero Model Training: Enterprise organizational data is never utilized to train public machine learning or third-party foundational models.

sections.title: Data Security, Retention, and Statutory Rights

paragraphs.text: Data Security, Retention, and Statutory Rights

All platform traffic is encrypted in transit with TLS 1.3 and at rest with AES-256. Workspaces maintain full data sovereignty with instant audit export capabilities and irrevocable data deletion upon account decommissioning.
• Statutory Compliance: Built to support compliance with NDPR, GDPR, and sovereign cloud data residency mandates.
